meta.title: The buying company cannot bid on its own event

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ; the caller is the buyer.
steps: The buyer sends POST /v1/bids with its own company uuid as company_uuid.
words.expected: The app refuses it: HTTP 422, code 165 'Cannot place bid on trade by your own company' — never a server error.

plan.title: The buying company cannot bid on its own event

act.say: The buyer opens a bid on its own event, sending its OWN company as the bidder.

expected.message: Cannot place bid on trade by your own company
